physical_hardware: one Blackhole chip on P300c boards
batch_context_semantics: Native context validated at batch 1; batches 1–32 including prime sizes validated with shorter per-user caches. Aggregate batch/context capacity depends on caller allocation.

linear_attention.state: FP32 recurrent matrix; persistent state in L1 within 300 KiB/bank, otherwise DRAM; intermediates within 224 KiB/bank, otherwise DRAM

full_attention.cache: BFP8 paged KV, 64-token pages, 4 KV heads, dimension 256

optional_yarn.status: opt-in setup supported; million-token full-layer capacity/accuracy not claimed by this native-context stage

previous_stage_capacity_validation: Packed BF16 projections, prepared depthwise convolution weights, and temporary L1/sharded rotary layouts retain native capacity. Final fused tests execute both layer kinds through 262144-token prefill and traced decode at position 262143; batch 32 is validated at shorter contexts. KV dtype and recurrent-state dtype are unchanged.

optimized_capacity_validation.logical_lengths: No public chunk/tile/page divisibility restriction; internally padded/chunked. 262143 and 262144 prefill tested for both layer kinds.
optimized_capacity_validation.kv_formula: 2 * (262144 / 32) * 4 * (256 / 32) * 1088 bytes; includes BFP exponent headers, excludes page-table and allocator bookkeeping.
optimized_capacity_validation.page_table: int32, 64-token blocks, logical page count padded to a multiple of 32 entries; native batch1 has 4096 entries (16384 bytes).
optimized_capacity_validation.projection_weights: BFP4/LoFi, original checkpoint packing; separate DRAM-interleaved prefill and DRAM-width-sharded decode copies. Unused packed MLP weight removed.

dominant_projection_weight_bytes.accounting: 576 bytes per 32x32 BFP4 tile; decode widths padded for 8 DRAM banks and selected readers. Excludes small norms, convolution, RoPE, program/trace buffers and construction-time temporary weights.

optimized_capacity_validation.trace_and_activation_contract: Decode residuals/norms width-sharded; grouped rotary/SDPA grids adapted for all supported batches. Leading unaligned prefill decode outputs are collected in DRAM immediately, preserving borrowed inputs and bounded L1 use.
optimized_capacity_validation.native_context_checks: Both kinds prefill 262143/262144 and traced decode position262143; 2048-vs1024 chunk-size tail PCC0.999958 linear /0.999950 full; different large/small matmul K blocks reassociate accumulation. Real-weight HF prefill/decode at8001; full native cache decode oracle PCC0.99821247. Native full-prefix HF rollout is not claimed.
